content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body:
Hi,

I have reviewed the agreement and would like to suggest a couple of adjustments before signing:

- The relevant clause states that invoices are payable Net 90, which could strain cash flow. I propose changing it to Net 30, while keeping the same interest provision for late payment.
- The relevant clause lists the payment period as Net 90, which may also affect cash flow. I propose revising it to Net 30.

Thank you for considering these changes. I look forward to your reply.

Best regards,
